items.q: Are NeuroUX scores validated predictions of user behavior?
items.a: No. NeuroUX is an experimental application built around predicted brain responses and transparent region-weighting formulas. Its UX and virality scores are exploratory proxies, not validated forecasts of actual audience behavior. The repository reports hardware-specific inference improvements; without model weights, a deterministic stub exercises the application pipeline and must not be mistaken for neuroscience inference.
